title: Tax startup CEO allegedly faked CPA credentials and company revenue to raise $13.3 million
summary_full: Federal agents arrested a former startup executive in Florida just as she was set to board a cruise ship. She is accused of swindling over $13 million from venture capital funds by falsely portraying herself as a licensed CPA while fabricating revenue reports. It is alleged that the funds were misappropriated for personal luxuries, including an extravagant wedding, leaving investors with substantial financial setbacks after her company's abrupt downfall.
